6. Scale path: from 3 test agencies to 32, more sources (SAM.gov, USDOT, foundations), feedback loop, statewide reporting schema (organizer threat 4). Is it concrete and ordered?
7. Could a non-technical budget director say the next step after the 6 minutes? Write the sentence they would say, or say where it breaks.
